name: WaBotDeploy
description: Self-hostable single-bot WhatsApp hosting platform. Forks a configurable bot repo, gives users a session-based deploy form, and runs each session in an isolated slot.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the /admin login page. Required.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random string used to sign cookies. Required.

BOT_REPO_URL.description: GitHub URL of the bot you want to host. Read on first boot; can be changed later from /admin.

SLOT_COUNT.description: How many concurrent user sessions the platform allows.

MAX_CONCURRENT_BOTS.description: Hard cap on simultaneously running bot child processes. Tune to dyno memory.

PLATFORM_SOURCE_URL.description: Optional URL the landing page Source button points to (your fork on GitHub).
